readBy: Signal routine every 15 min, 9:45 AM - 3:15 PM ET (America/Toronto). Each run re-reads this file.
execution: Kiwi leads: orders are sent without waiting for K's go; K approves each one in the Questrade app. Every bot trades its strategy on every valid signal, subject to the risk block below (Risk Manager enforces).

risk.sizing: shares = floor(40 CAD / (|entry - stop| in CAD + est. fees per share)); then cap so the order's cost fits current Questrade buying power left after open positions. USD risk converted at data.json fees.usdcad.rate. If the capped size is under 1 share (or 1 spread), skip.
risk.dailyStopCheck: Before each order: today's realized loss + open risk to every working stop + this trade's risk must be <= 150 CAD. Once today's realized + unrealized P&L <= -150 CAD: no new orders, cancel working entries, flatten.
risk.stopOrders: Every entry goes with its stop (bracket or stop placed immediately after the fill). No averaging down, no widening stops.
risk.note: No desk-wide trade cap (K chose every valid signal); per-strategy caps below plus the 150 CAD daily stop bound the day. 150/40 = at most 3 full-size stop-outs before the stop is close.

strategies.name: Big-gap fade (0.75x ATR14)
strategies.tested: active (XIU.TO); testing (SOFI, HXT.TO) - all trade per K's every-signal choice

stats.source: /workspace/quant/eod/2026-11-02/recheck_output.txt (daily bars Oct 2024 - Nov 2 2026, after Questrade fees + 0.02%/side slip)

HXT.TO.why: recent edge gone; 42 of 49 signals on the same days as XIU

strategies.entry: At the open: gap = open - prior close. If |gap| >= 0.75 x ATR14 (ATR from daily bars through yesterday), fade it: gap up -> short, gap down -> long, entry at the open price. Because the first routine run is 9:45 ET, enter at the 9:45 run only if price is still on the gap side of the open by <= 0.25 x gap (i.e. not already more than a quarter of the way to target) and still beyond the stop; otherwise no trade.
strategies.stop: One gap beyond the open: short stop = open + |gap|; long stop = open - |gap|.
strategies.timeStop: Exit at market 15:50 ET if neither stop nor target hit.
strategies.notes: Backtest assumes fill at the 9:30 open; a 9:45 fill is untested and will differ. HXT.TO duplicates XIU on most days: if XIU fires in the same direction, HXT is the second trade and doubles one bet (Risk Manager counts both against the 150 CAD stop). SHORTS need a shortable borrow in Questrade.

entry.orb: Opening range = high/low of 9:30-9:45 ET. LONG when a 5-min bar CLOSES above the OR high, with that bar's relative volume >= 1.5 (vs the same 5-min slot's 20-day average), price above session VWAP, and today's open above yesterday's close (trend filter). SHORT is the mirror (close below OR low, below VWAP, open below prior close). Only the first breakout of the day counts; skip if OR width > 1.0 x ATR14(daily) or < 0.1 x ATR14.
entry.vwap: After 10:30 ET: LONG when a 15-min bar closes back above VWAP after the prior bar closed below it (reclaim), RVOL >= 1.5 on that bar, and price above yesterday's close. SHORT when a bar closes below VWAP after closing above it (loss), RVOL >= 1.5, price below yesterday's close. First signal per ticker per day.

stop.orb: Opposite side of the opening range (long stop = OR low; short stop = OR high).
stop.vwap: Beyond the extreme of the signal bar and the bar before it (long: lower low of the two; short: higher high). Min stop distance 0.05% of price.

strategies.timeStop: Exit at market 15:50 ET; also exit an ORB trade at 12:30 ET if it is not at +0.5R.

strategies.entry: From 10:00 ET: a 5-min bar with relative volume >= 2.0 (vs the same slot's 20-day average) that CLOSES above the session high so far with price above VWAP -> LONG at the bar close; or closes below the session low so far with price below VWAP -> SHORT. strategies.name: News-catalyst momentum (pullback hold)
strategies.untestedWhy: No archive of timestamped headlines matched to intraday bars, so the rule can't be backtested with the data on hand.
universe: Any US or TSX stock with average daily volume >= 1M shares and price >= 5 (CAD/USD); no OTC, no halted names
strategies.entry: A fresh headline (company-specific: earnings, guidance, M&A, FDA, contract, analyst action; from the desk's news/X/filings sources) published <= 60 min before the signal. Price has moved >= 2% from the pre-headline price in the headline's direction, on relative volume >= 2.0. Wait for the first pullback: a 5-min bar that retraces toward VWAP or the 9-EMA but holds (closes above VWAP for longs / below for shorts), then enter on the break of that pullback bar's high (long) or low (short).
strategies.stop: Below the pullback low (long) / above the pullback high (short); skip if that is wider than 1.5 x ATR14(5-min) or if 40 CAD buys less than 1 share.
strategies.target: 2.0R; or trail the rest under each higher 5-min low after +1R.
strategies.timeStop: Exit if not at +0.5R within 45 min of entry; hard exit 15:50 ET.
strategies.notes: No trades into scheduled macro releases (economic calendar) or halts.

strategies.name: Defined-risk debit spreads
strategies.untestedWhy: No historical option-chain (bid/ask) data on hand; Questrade connector gives current chains only.
strategies.entry: Only as the options expression of another bot's valid signal on the same underlying (direction from that signal): buy a vertical debit spread (call spread for long, put spread for short), long leg at or 1 strike in the money, short leg 1-2 strikes out. Total debit x 100 x contracts + fees <= 40 CAD. Expiry >= 1 trading day out (no 0DTE) and <= 10 DTE. Each leg's bid/ask spread must be < 10% of its mid and open interest >= 500. Limit order at the spread mid (one 15-min re-price toward natural, then cancel).
strategies.stop: Max loss = debit paid (<= 40 CAD); also close if the underlying hits the source signal's stop.
strategies.target: Close at +80% of the debit, or when the underlying hits the source signal's target.
strategies.timeStop: Close the spread by 15:45 ET (same-day only).
strategies.notes: 40 CAD max loss means very narrow spreads on high-priced underlyings (about 0.25-0.40 USD debit after FX). Counts as one open position; underlying signal and spread together count as two if both are taken.
